title: Staff Software Engineer - Search Platform
description: P-375 Staff Software Engineer (L6) Location: Bangalore, India At Databricks, we are passionate about enabling data teams to solve the world's toughest problems — from making the next mode of transportation a reality to accelerating the development of medical breakthroughs. We do this by building and running the world's best data and AI infrastructure platform so our customers can use deep data insights to improve their business. Founded by engineers — and customer obsessed — we leap at every opportunity to tackle technical challenges, from designing next-gen UI/UX for interfacing with data to scaling our services and infrastructure across millions of virtual machines. And we're only getting started. The Search team sits at the forefront of advancing AI/ML-powered products at Databricks. As customers continuously create new assets on the platform — tables, notebooks, dashboards, pipelines, models, and more — finding the right asset becomes critical to their success. You will lead enhancements to search quality, focusing on ranking, query understanding, evaluation frameworks, and asset coverage to enable seamless search at scale. The Impact You Will Have - Lead the design and implementation of ML-based search and discovery systems that power asset retrieval across the Databricks platform. - Build automated ML and NLP pipelines for data preprocessing, query understanding, ranking, and model evaluation to enable rapid experimentation. - Drive technical strategy for search relevance, applying large language models and advanced NLP techniques to improve user experience. - Establish robust evaluation frameworks for search ranking improvements, including offline metrics and online experimentation. - Collaborate with product management and cross-functional teams to shape the roadmap for search and discovery experiences. - Mentor engineers and raise the technical bar for machine learning and search engineering across the organization. What We Look For - 8+ years of software engineering experience. - Experience developing search relevance systems at scale in production or high-impact research environments. - Experience applying large language models to search relevance problems. - Strong background in one or more areas including query understanding, NLP, text mining, recommendations, personalization, or conversational AI. - Deep understanding of computer science fundamentals and distributed systems. - Proven ability to lead complex technical projects from conception through delivery. - Strong collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to influence technical direction across teams. - B.S., M.S., or Ph.D. in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. About Databricks Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. Headquartered in San Francisco with 30+ offices around the globe, Databricks offers a unified platform that includes Genie, Lakebase, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakehouse, and Unity Catalog.
